question_text: A foreign investor from Japan wants to buy a 10-hectare agricultural land in Davao for a resort development. Which of the following statements best reflects the constitutional limitation on foreign ownership of land under Article XII of the 1987 Philippine Constitution?

options.text: The investor may buy the land outright because the Constitution allows foreign ownership of agricultural land for tourism purposes.
The investor may acquire the land through a long-term lease of up to 50 years, renewable for another 25 years, but cannot own it.
The investor may own the land if he partners with a Filipino citizen who holds at least 60% of the capital.
The investor may own the land if he secures a special permit from the Department of Agrarian Reform.
